# PixelTalk

> Real-time pixel-infused messaging application. Low-noise lounges, frictionless text, and tactile retro-micro visuals. Built for focused communities, creators, and teams who value calm, authentic communication.

## Core Information
- Website: https://pixel-talk-qofh.vercel.app
- Application Type: Real-time web messenger & community lounge
- Platform: Modern web browsers (Desktop & Mobile)
- Version: 1.0.4
- Architecture: Next.js 14 (App Router) + Node.js Express + Socket.IO + MongoDB Atlas + Redis Cloud + WebRTC

## Key Features
- **Direct Messaging (`/chat`)**: 1-on-1 encrypted conversations with instant delivery, read receipts, typing indicators, and message reactions.
- **Community Lounges (`/rooms`)**: Public, invite-only, and passcode-protected themed rooms with live member presence and retro aesthetics.
- **Voice & Video Calling**: Low-latency WebRTC peer-to-peer audio and video calling with spatial audio filters.
- **Tactile Pixel UI**: Hand-crafted 8-bit retro theme, custom avatar catalog, animated pixel landscapes, and zero generic bloat.
- **Zero Noise Philosophy**: No algorithmic feeds, intrusive tracking, or engagement traps. Pure, intentional communication.

## Authenticated Core Routes
- Player Dashboard: `/dashboard`
- Direct Messages: `/chat` & `/chat/[conversationId]`
- Community Rooms: `/rooms` & `/rooms/[conversationId]`
- Player Profile: `/profile` & `/profile/[username]`
- App Settings: `/settings`
- Restricted Admin Console: `/admin`

## API Endpoints (REST & WebSocket)
- `POST /api/auth/register` - Create new player account (requires email OTP verification)
- `POST /api/auth/login` - Authenticate player session (sets HttpOnly cookie)
- `POST /api/auth/logout` - Invalidate session tokens
- `GET /api/conversations` - List active direct conversations
- `GET /api/conversations/rooms` - Discover active community rooms
- `GET /api/messages/:conversationId` - Fetch paginated conversation history
- `POST /api/messages` - Send new real-time message
- `GET /api/health` - System diagnostics, uptime, and database connectivity
